notes.title: Special streaming of Kemono Heroes at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Don't miss the special streaming for the new Steam Next Fest in June! Kemono Heroes is a 2D pixel-art adventure game with coop for up to 4 players!

Play the demo now on Steam Next Fest and don't forget to add it to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2787700?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=steamfest&utm_medium=steamevent
